title: A first Codex /login cannot replace an existing file-backed API-key sign-in in TermAl's default profile
outcome: A user whose standalone Codex is signed in with an API key can enroll a TermAl-managed ChatGPT account with /login without first signing out in standalone Codex.
acceptance: A first /login from a default profile holding a supported file-backed API-key sign-in starts the browser login instead of refusing it, shown by a behaviour test.
After completion the strict ChatGPT identity check still applies, and an unsupported provider or forced API login stays refused.
The known-limitation paragraph in docs/features/codex-account-login.md is removed or updated accordingly.
